name: Workday
hint: An API client for integrations and its refresh token; View API Clients in Workday shows both addresses.

endpoints.name: list_workers
endpoints.description: Lists workers with their current job; search matches a name.

notes.search: Searches workers by name or worker ID. The search is case-insensitive. You can include space-delimited search strings for an OR search.
notes.email: Only return workers whose email matches.
notes.includeTerminatedWorkers: Include terminated workers in the output
notes.limit: The maximum number of objects in a single response. The default is 20. The maximum is 100.
notes.offset: The zero-based index of the first object in a response collection. The default is 0. Use offset with the limit parameter to control paging of a response collection. Example: If limit is 5 and offset is 9, the response returns a collection of 5 objects starting with the 10th object.

endpoints.name: get_worker
endpoints.description: Returns one worker and their current staffing information.

notes.ID: The Workday ID of the resource. Accepts: - **Workday ID**: Workday ID (32-character lowercase hexadecimal string). - **Reference ID**: Workday reference ID (Type=Value). Valid types: Employee_ID, Contingent_Worker_ID - **Named entry**: Valid values: `me`.
